info.title: Smart Afya Solution
info.description:
Production-ready mental health consultation API.

Roles: **client** | **doctor** | **admin**

Authenticate via `/api/v1/auth/login` → use the returned JWT as `Bearer <token>`.

post.description:
Register a new client or doctor account.

**Request body example:**
```json
{
  "full_name": "Jane Doe",
  "email": "jane@example.com",
  "phone": "+255700000000",
  "password": "Secret@123",
  "role": "client"
}
```

Authenticate and receive a JWT access token.

**Request body example:**
```json
{
  "email": "jane@example.com",
  "password": "Secret@123"
}
```

**Response example:**
```json
{
  "access_token": "<jwt>",
  "token_type": "bearer"
}
```

schema.title: Response List All Bookings Api V1 Bookings  Get

post.description:
Client submits a mental health consultation booking.

**Consent is required** — `consent_given` must be `true` or the request is rejected.
At least **3 preferred dates** must be provided.

**Request body example:**
```json
{
  "mental_health_description": "I have been experiencing anxiety for 3 months...",
  "consent_given": true,
  "session_type": "video",
  "duration_minutes": 60,
  "preferred_dates": ["2024-07-01T10:00:00Z", "2024-07-02T14:00:00Z", "2024-07-03T09:00:00Z"],
  "preferred_specialist_id": null
}
```

get.description: Client: list my bookings.

schema.title: Response My Bookings Api V1 Bookings My Get

get.description: Get a booking by ID. Clients can only view their own bookings.

post.description: Client cancels a booking and linked session.
Client requests new preferred dates (admin coordinates).

get.description:
- Admin: all sessions
- Doctor: their assigned sessions

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api V1 Sessions  Get

get.description: Get session details.

patch.description: Doctor or Admin update session status/notes.

post.description:
Admin assigns a doctor to a session and sets the schedule.

**Request body example:**
```json
{
  "doctor_id": "<uuid>",
  "scheduled_at": "2024-07-02T10:00:00Z",
  "meeting_link": null
}
```
Doctor checks in at the physical visit location.
Doctor checks out after completing the physical visit.

Doctor marks themselves unavailable for a session.
System notifies patient and returns available options.

**Response example:**
```json
{
  "message": "Marked unavailable. Patient notified.",
  "options": ["transfer_to_another_specialist", "reschedule_session"],
  "session_id": "<uuid>"
}
```

schema.title: Response Mark Unavailable Api V1 Sessions  Session Id  Unavailable Post

post.description:
Doctor requests a transfer to another specialist. Patient must accept or decline.
Reason is required. Admin is notified. Session data and notes are kept; on approval a transfer log is created.

post.description: Patient: transfer to another specialist or reschedule after doctor unavailability.
Doctor: mark a time range unavailable; affected patients receive actionable tasks.

get.description: Doctor: counts for operational follow-ups (transfer requests + unavailability impacts awaiting patient).
Admin: list all payments.

schema.title: Response List Payments Api V1 Payments  Get

post.description:
Admin creates a payment record for a session.
For physical sessions the amount may be null (negotiated manually).

**Request body example:**
```json
{
  "session_id": "<uuid>",
  "amount": 50000,
  "payment_type": "fixed",
  "reference": null
}
```

patch.description: Admin updates payment amount, status, or reference.

get.description: Get a payment record by ID.
Get payment details for a specific session (client, assigned doctor, or admin).
Admin: view all feedback (read-only — cannot edit or delete).

schema.title: Response List All Feedback Api V1 Feedback  Get

post.description:
Client submits feedback after a completed session.
Includes treatment rating, doctor feedback, app rating, and suggestions.

**Request body example:**
```json
{
  "session_id": "<uuid>",
  "treatment_rating": 5,
  "doctor_feedback": "Very professional and empathetic.",
  "app_rating": 4,
  "app_feedback": "Smooth experience, could use dark mode.",
  "suggestions": "Add in-app messaging between sessions."
}
```

get.description: Client: list all feedback I've submitted.
